planPhases.title: Create ProfilePage (src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx) — view/edit mode, PATCH only changed fields, password change, localStorage update on success
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx with view/edit mode toggled by 'Edit Profile' button. Edit form has username, email, and collapsible password section (currentPassword, newPassword, confirmNewPassword). PATCH /api/users/me with only changed fields; sends nothing if nothing changed. On success calls updateUser() from AuthContext (which updates both state and localStorage). On 409 shows error below relevant field; on 400 shows error below currentPassword field. Also added updateUser action to AuthContext (updates localStorage and React state). Build passes; 3 NavBar auth test failures are phase-8 work (unchanged from before).

planPhases.title: Update NavBar to show Sign Up/Log In when logged out and username/Log Out when logged in
planPhases.notes: Updated NavBar.tsx to use useOptionalAuthContext (added to AuthContext.tsx alongside existing useAuthContext). When user is null: shows Sign Up (/signup) and Log In (/login) NavLinks. When user is set: shows username span and Log Out button that calls auth.logout() and navigates to /login. Using optional accessor avoids throwing when NavBar renders without AuthProvider (existing tests render App directly). All 32 tests pass, build succeeds.
